title: Start with the job
description: Define the report-import task and the code that performs it. The Dockerfile packages that code; it is not the beginning of the business solution.

title: Record the dependencies
description: The package files record the software the worker needs. The lockfile preserves selected versions and download fingerprints.

title: Choose the build inputs
description: The Dockerfile describes the image and the build context supplies its files. The ignore file limits this context to package files and source.

title: Build the image
description: Docker combines the pinned browser base, installed packages and worker code into an image. It sets the working folder, lower-permission user and default command.

title: Verify the packaged runtime
description: The final verification stage runs a fictional browser check as the selected image user. This is a build check, not permission to sign into CareBridge.

title: Review software security
description: The platform checks selected software and exact image bytes with its security tooling. Findings and software inventories remain evidence for the release decision.

title: Store it in the registry
description: Azure Container Registry stores the image for later use. A tag is a convenient name, while the registry digest identifies the selected manifest.

title: Check release evidence
description: The reviewed signing path binds release-selection evidence to the selected image and accepting source. It does not by itself prove which original build produced that image.

title: Select the deployment image
description: The deployment process changes the registered job to the intended image digest. It checks existing settings and identity so an image update does not silently activate other behavior.

title: Activate work separately
description: A job execution creates a running container from the selected image. Scheduling, enable switches and the application work lease separately control whether real report work is allowed.

title: Observe useful outcomes
description: Logs and saved records show whether a run started, checked unchanged data or committed an import. A started container alone does not establish that a business report was imported.

title: Keep a recovery path
description: Retain the required previous image and reconcile unfinished work before a rollback. Replacing an image does not restore a provider session, database or saved report state.
